content.heading: graphbrowser - the dependency graph, one layer at a time
content: **graphbrowser** describes a website's external dependency graph one layer at a time, as structured markdown with hyperlinks for navigating between graph nodes.

content.heading: the pagerts counterpart, as a GUI
content: a way to visualise page dependencies without having to view the page content: the set of navigable items of a webpage, linking from page to page across the web.

**graphbrowser** is the GUI counterpart of [**pagerts**](/projects/pagerts), built with Quarkus and web technologies - the same dependency list pagerts parses with JSDOM into `title`, `url` and `resources`.
